system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
Attempt to reproduce the results from this
research paper using the available NACC
dataset.
system_prompt_style.note: Figure 3 shows a template with {abstract}, {methods}, {filepath} placeholders. Per-agent role descriptions are fixed strings (Fig. 2). Only the paper was available; there is no code, so the quote is from figure text. The line break in the quote reflects the PDF extraction.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
the initial prompt included manually selected
variables from the NACC data dictionary relevant for replicating the study
env_context_strategy.note: The data-dictionary fields are injected into the prompt, and the agents explore the data by executing code. None of the allowed values fits exactly; closest value chosen.

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no config or history-processing surface is available.

observation_format.evidence_quote:
react to stimuli and code outputs, correct error
code
observation_format.note: Inferred that code-execution output is returned as text.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Executor - a special non-LLM agent which executes Python code passed from the Engineer.

tool_count.note: No tool schema is reported. Code execution is handled by the Executor agent.

edit_primitive.note: Paper only; no tool registry is available.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
an agent "manager" is declared, which facilitates agent-to-
agent communication and chooses the next appropriate agent as "speaker"
loop_primitives.note: The group-chat speaker selection is closest to event_driven. The quote uses the PDF's curly quotes; see the next cell's risk note.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Planner - suggests and revises a plan for the agent team to follow based on instructions from the user.
planning_granularity.note: The plan exists only as free text in the conversation; there is no stored plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
Manager - a special agent which orchestrates the team, chooses speakers, and broadcasts speaker
responses to other agents
multi_agent_topology.note: This is an AutoGen GroupChat with a manager selecting speakers. It is closest to orchestrator_workers; it could also be read as peer.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote:
Determines next speaker,
broadcasts conversation
to other agents

human_in_loop.evidence_quote:
We enabled the agents to seek user approval at key
decision points to keep the user in the loop and ensure transparency.
human_in_loop.note: The Planner revises the plan based on admin feedback, and approval to complete is sought from the user.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Critic - critiques the plan and provides feedback for improvement.
self_verification.note: The Critic is a separate role running the same model (GPT-4o).

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
if the agents sought
approval to complete the exercise

execution_isolation.note: The dataset is stored locally, but the executor sandbox is not described.

tracing.evidence_quote:
transcripts of LLM agent responses, actions and code are
available
tracing.note: The transcript format is unknown, so this could be logs rather than structured traces.

target_domain.evidence_quote:
tasked with writing and executing code to dynamically reproduce
the findings of each study

open_source.note: The paper states that code will be made available upon acceptance. No LICENSE file is in the evidence.

model_agnostic.note: Only GPT-4o was used. AutoGen's model abstraction is not evidenced here.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Code will be made available upon article acceptance

first_release_date.note: Fallback to the paper v1 date, since no repository tag is available.

pinned_version.note: The only version information is 'Autogen version 2'; there is no commit.
